generate_golden_checkpoints: generate golden checkpoint test files for sonnet conformance tests using the generate.py binary
regenerate_golden_checkpoints: regenerate existing golden checkpoint files by running generate.py with --regenerate=true
filter_golden_checkpoints: filter golden checkpoint generation to a specific name pattern using the --filter flag
dry_run_checkpoint_generation: preview golden checkpoint generation without writing files by running with --dry_run=true
create_golden_checkpoint_dir: create a directory for golden checkpoint files using safe_mkdir with dry run support
